subline.en: Performance marketing, CRM and martech automation for B2B and B2C platforms across Southeast Asia. 10+ years, from paid media to the workflows behind it.

summary.en: Marketing professional with 10+ years in performance marketing, growth, CRM and data analytics across Southeast Asia. Delivered 150% YoY growth at Igloo Insurtech while onboarding 10,000+ agents across markets. Managed $50K+/month paid budgets and cut CPA by 22% at Metrixa. Combines paid media, CRM automation and analytics to build compounding growth systems.

achievements: Secured 500+ travel agents globally with a focus on Southeast Asian markets
Grew the platform to 5,000+ monthly visitors from a pre-launch baseline through targeted digital campaigns
Expanded tour operator partnerships through B2B relationship development
